jobs.title: Base Labs Research Scientist - RL Environments
jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

About Base Labs

Base Labs is Baseten’s research lab, working to advance and democratize open-source intelligence. We publish our research, methods, and results so others can inspect, reproduce, and build on them. Baseten’s training and inference infrastructure gives us a place to test ideas at scale, while our work with companies deploying models keeps us close to the problems those models need to solve.

THE ROLE

Models learn from the environments we give them. If a reward is easier to exploit than a task is to solve, a model can learn the shortcut. If a task measures the wrong capability, a higher score tells us little about progress. Building good environments requires decisions about what to teach, how to measure it, and how to establish whether it transfers.

As a Research Scientist at Base Labs specializing in RL environments, you will create open environments and study how models learn from them. You will design tasks and rewards, develop methods for generating and calibrating environments at scale, and run the training experiments needed to understand their effects.

There is substantial reinforcement learning research in this work. We want to understand how task diversity affects generalization, how curricula should change as models improve, and which reward structures produce reliable learning. Your findings will inform both the environments we release and the broader lab’s training research.

Responsibilities

Identify capabilities and failure modes worth studying, informed by real model use. These may include software development, tool use, scientific reasoning, and following complex instructions.
Design task distributions, interactions, rewards, and verifiers together. Establish that tasks are solvable and that success depends on the intended capability. Investigate shortcuts, ambiguous instructions, and weaknesses in grading.
Build methods that scale environment creation without weakening the quality standard. Study how to generate diverse tasks, calibrate difficulty, and detect defects before they spread through a large training pool.
Run RL experiments to measure learning and transfer. Compare curricula, task mixtures, and reward designs; investigate failed runs and unexpected behavior; test whether improvements hold on unseen tasks.
Develop evaluation methods that distinguish capability differences from sampling noise, grader errors, or artifacts of the agent’s tools and execution setup. Preserve the evidence needed to reproduce and challenge your conclusions.
Work with safety researchers on environments that reveal reward hacking and misalignment, and test ways to teach more reliable behavior.
Release environments, datasets, training recipes, and research findings that other teams can use. Make their assumptions, limitations, and measured effects clear.

Who We're Looking For

We look for evidence that you can choose a useful research question, design an informative experiment, implement it, and reason carefully about the result.

You should bring depth in a relevant area such as reinforcement learning, model evaluation, agent systems, synthetic data, or experimental methodology. You should be comfortable writing the code needed to build environments, run experiments, and inspect failures in detail. Experience with LLM training is valuable, as is experience building something that other researchers use.

Your evidence might be a paper, an open-source project or a strong experimental investigation. We also welcome exceptional people from adjacent fields. A PhD or a previous Research Scientist title is not required.

WORKING HERE

We are hiring across levels, with scope matched to experience. You will work closely with research engineers, applied researchers, and the wider Base Labs team. Senior hires will help establish research directions and mentor others. Everyone will contribute to the environments, methods, and published evidence on which the program grows.

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now
to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Cambridge, MA USA

THE ROLE

As a Senior Associate or Principal at Flagship Pioneering, you will be the protagonist entrepreneur behind a new company built on a pioneering scientific platform. Working side by side with an Origination Partner and using the Flagship model of company origination, you will ideate, research, and refine venture hypotheses, validate the key unknowns of biology or technology, and build pressure-tested ideas into a ambitious and pioneering NewCo. You will connect today’s work with long-term vision and value, understand optionality and paths to value, and navigate from the edges of today’s technology to tomorrow’s transformational biotech platform. You will become the expert on the foundational science of the company, frame and communicate its strategy, grow and manage a team and lead the plan that follows.

The Company

Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) conceives and develops first-in-category bioplatform companies to transform human health and sustainability. FSP has developed over 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $130 billion in aggregate value. FSP seeks to change the world by addressing some of humanity’s most urgent challenges: curing intractable diseases, improving human health, and feeding the world by advancing the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Key Responsibilities

Act as primary owner and driver of the company through each phase: exploration, ProtoCo, NewCo and into growth
Lead the loop between computational and experimental work: choose the questions and candidates to pursue, design creative experiments that test predictions, and drive wet lab execution across labs
Set IP strategy for the technology and company, write seminal patent applications, and assess the IP landscape, including key competitors
Develop the corporate strategy and operations plan: define value creation, prioritize the application spaces where the platform has an advantage, set goals and resourcing, and prepare for financing
Build relationships with academic leaders, industry and technology partners, and thought experts to validate and de-risk venture concepts, and develop audience-specific pitches that support business development and financingRecruit and manage the early scientific and computational team, advisors and CROs, set up lab facilities and early operations, and partner with Flagship operations teams and Pioneering Intelligence
Become the institutional subject matter expert and transfer that knowledge to the active company team. Stay current on literature, conferences, funding opportunities and new developments in AI/ML and chemistry

Who Thrives In This Role

You are a scientist-entrepreneur who has helped start something: a member of a founding team at the Senior Associate level, a founder at the Principal level. You bring technical grounding in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering, and the range to solve problems across disciplines as a generalist. You have fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech to hold a point of view and engage computational scientists in depth. You are comfortable driving wet lab work, operating in ambiguity, and originating first-in-category companies through the Flagship model.

Professional Experience & Qualifications

The ideal candidate has a STEM-based PhD or MD from a top university and a technical background in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering that equips them to solve problems across disciplines. Range, judgment and speed of learning count as much as depth in any single field. The candidate must have a passion for novel science and be operationally savvy.

Principal:
8 + years of experience, including founding or co-founding a company, platform or major scientific program. Primary owner of a pioneering scientific endeavor, with a track record of conceiving new science that formed the basis of a platform, and a demonstrated ability to build and lead teams and work with senior executives, boards and investors.

Senior Associate:
4 + years of experience in life sciences biotech, start-up or entrepreneurial activities, including as a member of a founding team with ownership of scientific or technical strategy and execution.

Important Skills And Capabilities Include

Proven ability to rapidly become conversant in new areas of science and engage thought leaders at the deepest technical level
Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and communicate a clear, compelling value proposition for a scientific opportunity to technical and non-technical audiences
Working knowledge of multiple therapeutic modalities of drug discovery
Working fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech: able to engage computational scientists at depth, navigate the model landscape to identify venture opportunities, and hold a clear point of view on how AI/ML will change the design and execution of scientific platforms and the future of biotech and company origination
Open, transparent communication, a passion for growth, willingness to engage in difficult conversations professionally, and a track record of giving, receiving and acting on feedback
Ability to work effectively in teams, lead and manage, and operate in an entrepreneurial environment with a sense of urgency

More About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. 

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Research Scientist / Engineer: Secure Systems
jobs.description:
The Secure Resilient Systems and Technology group advances cybersecurity research to address

critical national security challenges. We develop and evaluate technologies that enable mission systems, from space and autonomous platforms to tactical communications and secure computing, to withstand cyberattack and continue the mission. Our goal is not simply to identify vulnerabilities, but to design security in from the start and provide rigorous evidence that these systems can be trusted under attack.

Our research spans secure software and embedded systems, security architecture and threat modeling, applied cryptography, formal methods, and security evaluation. It increasingly includes the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, both using AI to advance cybersecurity and securing AI-enabled mission systems. We work across the R&D lifecycle, from new concepts through prototyping and transition to mission use, collaborating across Lincoln Laboratory and with government, industry, and academia. We maintain a strong focus on mission impact. As a result, our work spans multiple levels of sensitivity; whenever possible, we publish portions of our research and engage with the broader academic community.

We are a collegial and mission-driven team working on difficult problems where security, resilience, assurance, performance, and operational realities all matter. We value technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, inclusion, and individual growth. Our culture emphasizes mentoring and developing researchers into principal investigators (PIs) and technical leaders. We strive to bring out the best in our people and our systems, so that the Laboratory and the nation can count on them when it matters most.

If you would like to pursue cutting-edge research and work on things that truly matter at a place that combines MIT's culture of academic excellence, exceptional resources, and strong work-life balance, apply here to learn more.

Job Overview

MIT Lincoln Laboratory Technical Staff provide critical through expert multi-domain or new-domain innovative research supporting the Laboratory’s national security mission. They prototype state-of-the-art technology solutions and engage across the program lifecycle, leading projects or major/multiple technical workstreams in partnership with project, program and team/Group leaders. As a Technical Staff member, you will lead complex technical efforts requiring deep expertise, sound judgment, with the ability to successfully navigate technical complexity. Depending on the level, you will lead projects, major workstreams, complex programs, multi-program initiatives, or technical portfolios on extraordinary technology prototype efforts and creative new ideas and approaches that support critical mission needs. Depending on the level, you will translate broad Group strategy into clearly defined research or executional deliverables. Through integrating your deep technical expertise across disciplines, you consistently drive high-quality mission outcomes.

As a successful candidate, you will connect deep and diverse technical expertise with broader Laboratory objectives, perform independent research, develop creative approaches, and translate broad strategy into executable plans. You will work across or guide multidisciplinary teams through ambiguous trade-offs; helping develop and execute programs, creating briefings and reports, and often interfacing with sponsors. You effectively support sponsor, mission-partner, and Laboratory leadership’s needs through daily or weekly technical briefings, program documentation, proposals, and may conduct advanced capability road mapping and development. You will also guide and mentor Associate Technical Staff, Assistant Technical Staff, and other technical support personnel.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Amazon Leo Satellite Build Systems
jobs.description:
Description

Train the language model that knows how Amazon builds satellites. As an Applied Scientist II, you'll own the science of the training corpus (selection, deduplication, filtering, enrichment, and data mixture) and of efficient inference (distillation and quantization) for Leo's domain-specific language model, so it answers manufacturing, quality, and test questions accurately at a serving cost the factory can sustain.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Design the scientific components of the training-data pipeline: Source selection, deduplication within and across datasets, quality and perplexity filtering, poisoning detection, and sensitive-data screening
Develop enrichment methods (summaries, diagrams rendered as text, structured representations, synthetic data, and rare-fact detection) and measure what each one adds to model quality
Define data mixtures for continued pre-training and supervised fine-tuning, and run the ablations that justify them
Build task-specific benchmarks and in-training evaluations that catch regressions before a model ships
Work with scientists on reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, and with engineers on training and serving infrastructure

A day in the life

You start by reviewing last night's training run. An in-training evaluation shows a drop on test-procedure questions, and you trace it to a duplicated document cluster that crowded out rarer content. You write a cross-dataset deduplication pass and launch a small ablation. After lunch, you compare a distilled 4-bit model with the full-precision model on a nonconformance benchmark and find one failure class to fix before release. You end the day reviewing a teammate's enrichment experiment and updating the corpus bill of materials.

About The Team

Leo Intelligence Technologies is the central AI team in Leo Satellite Build Systems, and we're growing! We build shared AI capabilities for Production Operations: Governed data, a domain-specific language model, retrieval and knowledge services, evaluation frameworks, and agentic workflows that factory teams use every day. Our work changes real manufacturing decisions, so we value rigorous experiments, strong data foundations, clear documentation, and production-ready engineering. Scientists and engineers work side by side, and scientists take their work from experiment to production.

Basic Qualifications

Master's degree or above in computer science, machine learning, engineering, or related fields
3+ years of building models for business application experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development
Experience with LLM pre-training, continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human or verifiable feedback
Experience building training-data pipelines for language models, including deduplication, quality filtering, synthetic data generation, or data mixture selection
Experience designing benchmarks for domain-specific or task-specific language models
Experience working with technical, regulated, or access-controlled data

jobs.description:
Description

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

Sponsored Services is Amazon's performance advertising solution for local and online service providers (plumbers, restaurants, salons, fitness instructors, and more), connecting them with high-intent Amazon customers through a conversational AI ad format that completes outcomes — quote requests, bookings, reservations, calls — directly within the ad. Demand comes from three advertiser cohorts (3P marketplace partners such as Yelp, Thumbtack, and Angi; agencies; and direct advertisers), and the program is rolling out across closed beta, open beta, and General Availability, scaling from one vertical at open beta to five-plus by end of 2027.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to build models that power GenAI ad experiences, ad sourcing, ranking and auction for optimization of consumer and advertiser outcomes. You will own scientific problems from definition through production launch.

Key job responsibilities

Service intent detection: Build models that infer a service need from purchases, browsing, and Alexa+ conversations. Extend the current LLM classification of about 30,000 browse nodes to real-time, per-customer signals.
Outcome and click prediction: Predict the probability of a click and of a completed outcome (call, quote request, appointment, reservation, food order). Keep the models accurate on sparse early data, because CPO pricing depends on them.
Auction ranking and pricing: Work with ads engineering to extend the auction for CPO bidding. Develop ranking signals such as predicted outcome rate, provider responsiveness and ratings. Set and recalibrate CPO floors by vertical, geography and placement.
Conversational AI ad experience: Develop multi-turn flows that ask 2-4 qualifying questions and complete the task inside the ad. This includes the Sponsored Services Sub-Agent and the Alexa+ integration. Define evaluation methods for answer quality, task completion and safety.
Outcome validity and fraud detection: Build models that screen invalid outcomes before billing, such as short or unanswered calls and repeat contacts within 30 days. Use call-tracking data to score call quality.
Measurement and attribution: Design experiments and metrics for lead quality, outcome rate and revenue per thousand impressions (RPM). Develop the attribution approach, including the proposed 7-day click-through window.
Scientific leadership: Write and review design documents, present results to Product, Engineering and Ads leadership, mentor junior scientists, and raise the bar on experiment rigor.

Research publications or patents in generative AI technologies

jobs.description:
Work Schedule

First Shift (Days)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

Sr. Research Scientist - Protein Biologics Analytics

Shift: Full-Time; Monday – Friday; 8am-5pm EST (Hybrid)

ONSITE:

This is a fully onsite role based at our customer’s site in (Boston, MA).
We welcome applicants from all locations within the US. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this position, and any relocation costs will be the responsibility of the candidate. 

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Thermo Fisher's clinical research business is a leading global contract research organization and world leader in serving science. We are passionate, deliberate, and driven by our mission – to enable our customers to make the world healthier, safer, and cleaner.

Our Laboratories Functional Service Partnership (FSP) team plays a direct role in advancing drug development by creating sustained groups of talent within our customers’ organizations to provide long-term support. Through this collaborative approach, our professionals bring their commitment to excellence, industry knowledge, and operational strength directly into customer environments, helping to enhance capabilities and advance the delivery of life-changing therapies.

Key responsibilities:

Work independently or in collaboration with internal and/or external partners in analytical lifecycle activities for biologics, with emphasis on combination products such as protein, fusion protein and device, including method development, validation, and method transfer
Apply biochemical and physical chemistry techniques to characterize fusion proteins and other biologics, including assessment of critical quality attributes such as identity, purity, size and charge variants, aggregation, higher-order structure, stability, and potency-related attributes
Author and/or review technical documents, including method SOPs, study protocols, and technical reports
Review and verify analytical data for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with data integrity principles (e.g., ALCOA+) before reporting or release and perform data trending analysis
Be a key Subject Matter Expert (SME) and represent ASAT in troubleshooting and OOS investigations occurring during release and/or stability testing of biologics
Provide SME assessment for deviations, CAPA, and change control
Participate in internal and external meetings

Education and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in lab sciences such as Chemistry, Biochemistry, Material Science, Immunology, Biology, Molecular Biology or similar
SRS:
Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 10+ years’)
OR Masters degree and previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable 8+ years’)
OR PhD and previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable 6+ years’)

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Excellent technical writing skills and attention to detail are essential
Hands-on experience and in-depth knowledge of protein analysis required, with experience in biologics and fusion proteins strongly preferred
Experience with biochemistry and physical chemistry techniques for the characterization of proteins (e.g., HPLC/UPLC [SEC, IEX, RP, HIC], capillary electrophoresis/CE-SDS, icIEF, peptide mapping and intact mass by LC-MS, glycan analysis, ELISA/binding assays, DLS, DSC, circular dichroism, and fluorescence spectroscopy)
Strong attention to detail, with a demonstrated commitment to accuracy and thoroughness in experimental execution, documentation, and reporting
Experience with data verification, including second-person review of raw data, calculations, and reported results, and a solid understanding of data integrity expectations
Knowledge of relevant ICH and regulatory guidelines and good understanding of GMP concepts
Experience with analytical support for late-stage or commercial biological products and cGMP manufacturing
Ability to prioritize objectives from multiple projects and adhere to scheduled timelines while maintaining flexibility and efficiency
Partners effectively with internal and external functions
Experience of using JMP or similar statistical tools is a plus
Experience in Cell and Gene Therapy is a plus

Working Environment:

Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:

Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.

Able to work upright and stationary and/or standing for typical working hours.

Able to lift and move objects up to 25 pounds

Able to work in non-traditional work environments.

Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with

proficiency.

May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements, including infectious agents, typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments.

Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities.

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer, Lead - Anthropic/Claude
jobs.description:
Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering
team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering
leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/22/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for leading the design and delivery of AI solutions for client engagements.

Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs
Own the design and architecture of Claude-based Generative AI and agentic solutions, including RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases, orchestration frameworks, memory/state patterns, and tool-use architectures, leveraging the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork
Design and implement cloud and hybrid data architectures, migration approaches, and technology solutions that support Claude/Anthropic deployments
Build and govern LLMOps practices, including evaluation frameworks, monitoring, prompt lifecycle management, and guardrails for production Claude deployments
Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships, aligning technical delivery with business and program objectives
Oversee the quality of team deliverables and recommendations, contributing hands-on to solution delivery when needed
Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market content related to agentic AI
Coach and upskill practitioners transitioning onto Generative AI and Claude-focused work

You'll be deployed onto client engagements that typically involve one or more of the following:

Leading the architecture and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI platforms powered by Claude, from design through production operation
Owning technical direction for multi-agent systems spanning orchestration, tool integration, memory/state management, and governance guardrails
Leading modernization of AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities such as RAG pipelines and agent-based orchestration
Advising client executives on Generative AI strategy, responsible AI practices, and model/platform selection
Managing cross-functional delivery teams and client relationships across the engagement lifecycle, while contributing to proposal and business development efforts

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data
practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

6+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production AI/ML solutions, including at least 1 year delivering production Generative AI or Agentic AI systems
3+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications in Python
At least 1 year of direct experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using the Claude Agent SDK, including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions, or MCP integrations
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models through the native Anthropic API or a supported cloud platform
At least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability, and usability of AI solutions
2+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering complex AI solution engagements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
Experience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research, or other knowledge-work use cases
Hands-on experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, agent evaluation, observability, safety controls, or production governance
Certifications such as Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P), Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F), or Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F)
Cloud certification(s) - AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessions
Experience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200 to $278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer, Lead - Anthropic/Claude
jobs.description:
Agentic AI is moving from experimentation to production, and organizations everywhere are racing to figure out how to build it responsibly and at scale. We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering
team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering
leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/22/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for leading the design and delivery of AI solutions for client engagements.

Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs
Own the design and architecture of Claude-based Generative AI and agentic solutions, including RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases, orchestration frameworks, memory/state patterns, and tool-use architectures, leveraging the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork
Design and implement cloud and hybrid data architectures, migration approaches, and technology solutions that support Claude/Anthropic deployments
Build and govern LLMOps practices, including evaluation frameworks, monitoring, prompt lifecycle management, and guardrails for production Claude deployments
Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships, aligning technical delivery with business and program objectives
Oversee the quality of team deliverables and recommendations, contributing hands-on to solution delivery when needed
Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market content related to agentic AI
Coach and upskill practitioners transitioning onto Generative AI and Claude-focused work

You'll be deployed onto client engagements that typically involve one or more of the following:

Leading the architecture and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI platforms powered by Claude, from design through production operation
Owning technical direction for multi-agent systems spanning orchestration, tool integration, memory/state management, and governance guardrails
Leading modernization of AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities such as RAG pipelines and agent-based orchestration
Advising client executives on Generative AI strategy, responsible AI practices, and model/platform selection
Managing cross-functional delivery teams and client relationships across the engagement lifecycle, while contributing to proposal and business development efforts

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data
practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

6+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production AI/ML solutions, including at least 1 year delivering production Generative AI or Agentic AI systems
3+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications in Python
At least 1 year of direct experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using the Claude Agent SDK, including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions, or MCP integrations
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models through the native Anthropic API or a supported cloud platform
At least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability, and usability of AI solutions
2+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering complex AI solution engagements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
Experience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research, or other knowledge-work use cases
Hands-on experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, agent evaluation, observability, safety controls, or production governance
Certifications such as Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P), Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F), or Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F)
Cloud certification(s) - AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessions
Experience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences

We're growing a team of engineers who want to work at the center of that shift: designing and building autonomous, multi-agent systems powered by Anthropic's Claude models for some of the world's largest organizations.

Join our AI & Engineering
team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering
leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/22/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for leading the design and delivery of AI solutions for client engagements.

Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs
Own the design and architecture of Claude-based Generative AI and agentic solutions, including RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases, orchestration frameworks, memory/state patterns, and tool-use architectures, leveraging the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork
Design and implement cloud and hybrid data architectures, migration approaches, and technology solutions that support Claude/Anthropic deployments
Build and govern LLMOps practices, including evaluation frameworks, monitoring, prompt lifecycle management, and guardrails for production Claude deployments
Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships, aligning technical delivery with business and program objectives
Oversee the quality of team deliverables and recommendations, contributing hands-on to solution delivery when needed
Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market content related to agentic AI
Coach and upskill practitioners transitioning onto Generative AI and Claude-focused work

You'll be deployed onto client engagements that typically involve one or more of the following:

Leading the architecture and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI platforms powered by Claude, from design through production operation
Owning technical direction for multi-agent systems spanning orchestration, tool integration, memory/state management, and governance guardrails
Leading modernization of AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities such as RAG pipelines and agent-based orchestration
Advising client executives on Generative AI strategy, responsible AI practices, and model/platform selection
Managing cross-functional delivery teams and client relationships across the engagement lifecycle, while contributing to proposal and business development efforts

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data
practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

6+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production AI/ML solutions, including at least 1 year delivering production Generative AI or Agentic AI systems
3+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications in Python
At least 1 year of direct experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using the Claude Agent SDK, including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions, or MCP integrations
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models through the native Anthropic API or a supported cloud platform
At least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability, and usability of AI solutions
2+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering complex AI solution engagements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred:

Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
Experience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research, or other knowledge-work use cases
Hands-on experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, agent evaluation, observability, safety controls, or production governance
Certifications such as Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P), Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F), or Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F)
Cloud certification(s) - AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience creating client workshop collateral and leading interactive working sessions
Experience presenting technical content to both large and small audiences

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200 to $278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Lead Engineer I, Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
Known for being a great place to work and build a career, KPMG provides audit, tax and advisory services for organizations in today's most important industries. Our growth is driven by delivering real results for our clients. It's also enabled by our culture, which encourages individual development, embraces an inclusive environment, rewards innovative excellence and supports our communities. With qualities like those, it's no wonder we're consistently ranked among the best companies to work for by Fortune Magazine, Consulting Magazine, Seramount, Fair360 and others. If you're as passionate about your future as we are, join our team.

KPMG is currently seeking a Lead Engineer I, Data and Information Architecture to join our Advisory Digital organization.

Responsibilities:

Design and deliver scalable, production-ready, cloud-first solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft 365 technologies
Lead the architecture and implementation of AI-enabled solutions utilizing Microsoft Foundry, agentic frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and related technologies
Develop and oversee containerized application platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps, Istio, and container image management best practices
Provide technical leadership by establishing architecture standards, influencing solution design decisions, and driving continuous improvements in delivery methodologies
Ensure solutions adhere to security, networking, infrastructure, and software development best practices while maintaining reliability, scalability, and compliance
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, communicating complex technical concepts effectively and mentoring teams on emerging technologies and industry trends
Act with integrity, professionalism, and personal responsibility to uphold KPMG's respectful and courteous work environment

Qualifications:

Minimum five years of recent professional experience in network administration, system administration, software development, information security, or related technical disciplines
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in computer science, engineering, or a related field or five years of equivalent practical experience is preferred or minimum of a high school diploma or GED is required
Proven experience designing and delivering cloud-first solutions on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft 365 platforms
Hands-on experience implementing AI and modern application architectures, including Microsoft Foundry, agentic frameworks, and RAG-based solutions as well as strong technical expertise with containerization technologies, including AKS, Azure Container Apps, Istio, and container lifecycle management
Experience with Microsoft and Azure data platforms, including Fabric, Power BI, Azure Databricks, Azure Synapse, SQL Server, DocumentDB, and Azure Data Factory
Strong communication and leadership skills, with demonstrated success influencing architecture decisions, establishing technical standards, and continuously adapting to emerging technologies
Applicant must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future; KPMG LLP will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H 1B, L 1, TN, O 1, E 3, H 1B1, F 1, J 1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

new_jobs.description:
About FullStack

FullStack is your AI-native engineering partner, built to turn AI capability into certainty. Most companies can demo AI; few can get it to production and prove what it produced. We close that gap with three capabilities, AI built into your products from the start, elite vetted talent who apply it, and transparent execution that shows value every step of the way. With now over 600 customers in North America, FullStack is one integrated partner for all your AI engineering needs. With FullStack, you move forward with confidence.

We’re Most Proud Of

Offering life-changing career opportunities to talented software professionals across the Americas.
Building highly-skilled software development teams for hundreds of the world’s greatest companies.
Having delivered hundreds of successful custom software solutions, which have positively impacted the lives and careers of millions of users.
Our 4.1-star rating on GlassDoor.
Our client Net Promoter Score of 68, twice the industry average.

The Position

We're Looking To Hire a Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer To Join Our Team. You'll Work With Our Incredible Clients In One Of Two Ways

Team Augmentation: You will integrate directly into our client's team and work alongside their existing designers and engineers daily.
Design & Build: You will work on a FullStack product team to build and deliver a product to our clients.

What We're Looking For

6+ years of professional software engineering experience.
Intermediate English or higher is required. Advanced English is a plus.
Bachelor's or technical degree in a related field (completed or in progress).
Has designed and shipped LLM-powered solutions to production, including RAG pipelines over enterprise data.
Has worked embedded with enterprise clients, owning the technical deployment of a platform in their environment, from rapid prototypes to production.
Has built custom integrations, data pipelines, and workflows that connect a platform to a client's enterprise systems through APIs.
Has troubleshot complex implementation issues directly with client stakeholders, managed the scope and delivery of those projects, and fed field feedback into a product team's roadmap.
Ability to work through new and difficult issues and contribute to libraries as needed.
Ability to create and maintain continuous integration and delivery of applications.
Forensic attention to detail.
A positive mindset and a can-do attitude.
Experience working on Agile/Scrum teams.
Meaningful experience working on large, complex systems.
Ability to take extreme ownership over your work. Every day is a challenge to ensure you are performing to the expectations you and your team have agreed upon.
Ability to identify with the goals of FullStack's clients and dedicate yourself to delivering on the commitments you and your team make to them.

Work Authorization Requirements

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. FullStack Labs is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position.
FullStack Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of citizenship status, immigration status, or national origin, or any other protected characteristic. FullStack Labs participates in E-Verify.

What We Offer

Competitive Salary.
Paid Time Off (vacation, sick leave, parental leave, holidays).
100% remote work.
The ability to work with leading startups and Fortune 500 companies.
Health, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) w/ 4% match.
Ample opportunity for career advancement.
Continuing education opportunities.

FullStack is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

Learn more about our Applicants Privacy Notice.

new_jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, AI Agent Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Nuro believes self-driving vehicles are the most immediate and profound opportunity for AI to drive positive change in the physical world. Safer streets, more time for what matters, and easier access to the world around us, that’s why we’re building a universal autonomy platform: self-driving for all roads and all rides.

Founded in 2016, Nuro is a physical AI company developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology for a wide range of vehicles, use cases, and markets. Powered by the Nuro Driver™, our universal autonomy platform enables the global mobility ecosystem to deploy autonomy at scale, from robotaxis and logistics fleets to personal vehicles.

With years of real-world deployment experience and a flexible, partner-led business model, Nuro is working toward a future where millions of autonomous vehicles powered by our technology help make everyday life safer, easier, and more connected.

Nuro has raised over $2B in capital from Uber, NVIDIA, Google, Softbank, Fidelity, T. Rowe Price, and other leading investors.

About The Team

Frontier models are fungible. Any team can rent the same intelligence we can, and the model we build on today will be replaced within a month. What is not fungible is the infrastructure that decides whether an autonomous system's output can be trusted — evaluation, verification, and the discipline to gate on evidence instead of impressions. Nuro has spent a decade building exactly that discipline for a robot that drives on public roads, and this team turns it inward: we build the platform that lets AI agents operate autonomously inside Nuro's own engineering organization, under the same standard of proof we apply to the vehicle.

Our mandate is to amplify the output of every engineer and researcher at Nuro by 100x. Not a better IDE, not a faster build — a change in what a single person can attempt. That number is a target, not a claim, and reaching it depends on one thing above all: autonomous work has to be trustworthy enough to run unattended. So our central ambition is to build the most rigorous closed-loop evaluation system for AI work anywhere. Leverage follows from trust, and trust follows from measurement.

We operate as a startup inside a company that has already shipped a hard thing. Small team, no established playbook, direct access to compute and to the systems we are automating. You will work directly with engineering leadership and the CEO, and the decisions you make will be yours to make rather than yours to implement.

About The Role

We already operate a substantial agent system in production — a fleet of agents with an extensive library of skills and plugins, integrated into the tools our engineers use daily. This role is about what it takes to make that system trustworthy, autonomous, and an order of magnitude more capable. Three things sit at the center of it.

Closed-loop evaluation.
Our ambition is to build the most rigorous evaluation system for AI work anywhere — closed-loop, meaning every agent action produces a measurable outcome that feeds back into whether that agent is trusted to act again. Acceptance, revert, and override rates per workflow. Statistical honesty about whether a difference is real. Regression detection that fires before a human notices. Everything else on this team depends on this being right, and almost nobody has built it well.

Agent platform.
The runtime that makes autonomous agents safe to run against real systems: orchestration, sandboxing and isolation, tool and skill frameworks, memory, identity and permissioning, and the gateway and observability layer underneath. Agents that touch production code and production infrastructure need containment and auditability before they need capability.

Autoresearch infrastructure.
The automation of the research loop itself: agents that read the current state of a model and its metrics, form a hypothesis, launch an experiment, evaluate the result honestly, and either propose a change or discard the idea and move on. At Nuro that loop runs against the training pipelines behind the driving model — real experiments, real compute budgets, real metrics that determine whether a behavior ships. The hard parts are trusting the measurement, surviving experiments that take days, spending finite research compute wisely, and producing proposals a skeptical researcher can audit and reject.

Alongside this, the team builds agent-powered tooling across the engineering lifecycle — code generation, review, debugging, test and CI failure attribution, knowledge retrieval, triage. There is also appetite on this team for post-training our own models where an internal workload justifies it, and the engineer in this role would be central to that work.

About The Work

What You Might Own in Your First Two Quarters

Build the closed-loop measurement layer that tells us, per workflow, whether agent output is accepted, reverted, or overridden — and use it to decide where autonomy expands and where it gets pulled back.
Take the autoresearch loop from assisted to unattended for a bounded class of experiments, including the eval and confidence machinery required to run it without a human in the loop.
Design the isolation and permissioning model that lets agents act on production repositories and infrastructure with an auditable record of what they did and why.

About You

5+ years of software engineering experience (or 4+ with a Master's) in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Staff-level candidates should bring correspondingly deeper scope and ownership.
Deep, current taste in LLM research. You understand how a model is trained from scratch — data, tokenization, architecture, pretraining dynamics, the full post-training stack of supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and RL — and you can reason about what a training decision does to model behavior. You follow the literature because you want to, not because it is on a roadmap.
You know what happens under the hood at inference. Attention and KV-cache behavior, batching and scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, prefix caching, context handling, and how each trades off latency, throughput, and cost.
You have built and operated LLM-based agent systems in production — tool use, orchestration, sandboxing, retrieval, memory — and you know where they break.
Strong backend and distributed systems background at scale: cloud infrastructure, service design, storage, queuing, and the judgment to build things that stay up.
Strong programming skills in Python.
You are opinionated about evaluation. You have argued with someone about whether a benchmark measured anything real, and you were right.
You work end-to-end and do not need the problem pre-decomposed. This role has more surface than a specification.
Hands-on post-training or fine-tuning experience — SFT, preference optimization, RL, distillation — including the evaluation work required to know whether it helped.
Experience with ML training or research infrastructure: experiment orchestration, evaluation pipelines, hyperparameter search, data pipelines.
Experience running inference serving, cost, or capacity at meaningful scale.
Familiarity with agent architecture patterns: planning, reflection, long-horizon memory, multi-agent coordination.
Experience with open tool-integration protocols, plugin or skill frameworks, and model-routing or gateway layers.
Background in developer experience or platform engineering, observability, or security isolation.
Go, C++, or Rust experience in addition to Python.

At Nuro, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected base pay range is between $193,930 and $352,290 for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus, equity, and a competitive benefits package.

Join our AI & Engineering
team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering
leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/22/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for leading the design and delivery of AI solutions for client engagements.

Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs
Own the design and architecture of Claude-based Generative AI and agentic solutions, including RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases, orchestration frameworks, memory/state patterns, and tool-use architectures, leveraging the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork
Design and implement cloud and hybrid data architectures, migration approaches, and technology solutions that support Claude/Anthropic deployments
Build and govern LLMOps practices, including evaluation frameworks, monitoring, prompt lifecycle management, and guardrails for production Claude deployments
Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships, aligning technical delivery with business and program objectives

Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market content related to agentic AI
Coach and upskill practitioners transitioning onto Generative AI and Claude-focused work

Leading modernization of AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities such as RAG pipelines and agent-based orchestration
Advising client executives on Generative AI strategy, responsible AI practices, and model/platform selection
Managing cross-functional delivery teams and client relationships across the engagement lifecycle, while contributing to proposal and business development efforts

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data
practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Required:

6+ years of experience designing, developing, and delivering production AI/ML solutions, including at least 1 year delivering production Generative AI or Agentic AI systems
3+ years of hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications in Python
At least 1 year of direct experience designing or implementing production agentic workflows involving capabilities such as orchestration, tool integration, state management, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing agentic AI solutions using the Claude Agent SDK, including agent orchestration, tool integration, permissions, or MCP integrations
At least 1 year of hands-on experience developing and deploying production solutions using Anthropic Claude models through the native Anthropic API or a supported cloud platform
At least 1 year of experience applying prompt engineering, context engineering, structured outputs, and related techniques to improve the performance, reliability, and usability of AI solutions
2+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering complex AI solution engagements
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI, or a related field
Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Experience in consulting or other client-facing delivery roles
Experience using Claude Cowork to support enterprise workflows, automation, research, or other knowledge-work use cases
Hands-on experience using Claude through one or more of the following: Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, or the native Anthropic API
Experience with multi-agent systems, MCP integrations, agent evaluation, observability, safety controls, or production governance
Certifications such as Claude Certified Architect - Professional (CCAR-P), Claude Certified Architect - Foundations (CCAR-F), or Claude Certified Developer - Foundations (CCDV-F)

Who We Are

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Role and Responsibilities

Successful candidate will work on development of Agentic OS infrastructures and algorithms to optimize agentic AI memory management and knowledge retrieval, model routing, advanced reasoning, validation, governance policies and guardrails, agentic observability, trace capture, and security across different agentic harnesses at a system level and at scale, to improve quality and portability of AI agentic workflows. Furthermore, the work will involve system layer development for augmentation and enhancement of agentic harnesses, at scale, across multiple agents and tenants. We are particularly interested in individuals with a background in both the agentic AI and operating systems, particularly in machine learning, deep learning, statistics, generative AI, data management for AI, AI model serving, security, and operating system development, with good understanding of the current state of the art, major trends and opportunities, and a demonstrated track record in innovative research. The ideal candidate can thrive in an applied research environment, balancing significant technical contributions published externally in open source with the hands-on engineering skill to bring such contributions to practice in partnering with our internal software development teams and external partners

PhD in Computer Science or related fields with a focus on Agentic AI and Operating Systems, in particular Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, plus 5 years of relevant industry experience

Research experience in Operating System development
Experience with advanced AI model architectures: LLMs, Time Series Foundation Models, Diffusion Models, etc.
Experience with Agentic AI platforms (e.g., OpenCode, Claude Code, LangGraph, ADK, Autogen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Academy, etc.)

Experience in system software performance and scalability optimization

Expertise with the data layer underlying the pipelines (e.g., DVC, lakeFS, Pachyderm, Common Metadata Framework, Flowcept) – a plus
Experience with multi-threaded programming, parallel processing, OOD/OOP/distributed programming – a plus

new_jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist, Multimodal Deep Learning and Risk Prediction
new_jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

Join our world-class Research team in the development of state-of-the-art automated machine learning technologies behind Heartflow’s products, including RoadMap, FFRCT Analysis, and Plaque Analysis used to help 750,000+ patients so far. Lead the development and evaluation of problems in Machine Learning and Medical Image Analysis, with a focus on deep learning models that combine 3D medical image data with other clinical data, and on using these multimodal models for risk prediction. Work closely with the Research, Engineering, Data Science and Product teams to develop new algorithms.

Job Description:

Solving cutting-edge scientific and technical challenges related to developing deep learning models using large-scale datasets, comprising volumetric images and associated clinical data.
Designing multimodal deep learning models that combine imaging with clinical and other data sources.
Developing models for time-to-event and risk prediction, matching model complexity and training objectives to the outcome data available.
