new_jobs.description:
CSQ128R208

PLEASE NOTE:
Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, U.S. citizenship and eligibility for a U.S. government secret clearance are required to access classified information. Candidates with an active Secret or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply.

About Databricks:
At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers and deeply customer-obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve hard technical challenges, from designing modern application interfaces to architecting highly available, distributed systems at massive scale. And we're only getting started.

The Role:
As a Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will be the principal technical authority working with our largest and most complex federal government customers to solve their most critical software, data, and AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will define the technical vision, pioneer novel system architectures, and lead the implementation of enterprise-scale applications spanning backend infrastructure, API integration, and AI-powered product development.

At the Senior Staff level, you are a force multiplier. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering leadership, product management, and developer relations. You will act as a trusted advisor to technical executives at customer organizations, integrating deeply with client codebases and systems while mentoring other FDEs and engineering teams. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for elite builders and technical strategists who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, distributed systems, and massive business impact.

Please note: this role is hybrid and has a requirement to travel to customer locations 20-25% of the time.

The Impact You Will Have

Strategic Solution Leadership: Lead the most complex and high-stakes customer technical projects. Pioneer and build robust, first-of-their-kind reference architectures, massive-scale custom enterprise applications, and seamless integrations with cutting-edge AI/ML models.
Enterprise Transformation: Drive executive-level technical strategy as strategic customers implement transformational software projects. Oversee the end-to-end design, build, and deployment of industry-leading, data-intensive AI applications across highly matrixed federal organizations.
Visionary Guidance: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite and VP-level customer stakeholders. Guide technical leadership on software architecture, system design, and platform adoption, successfully steering their long-term Databricks development strategy.
Architectural Pioneer: Own and define software architecture decisions for systems with unprecedented scale or security requirements. Ensure applications are secure, highly available, scalable, and set the standard for modern software engineering and Databricks best practices globally.
Deliver Technical Excellence: Orchestrate multi-team, multi-quarter technical engagements. Align Databricks technical teams, Architects, and Customer engineering leadership to ensure flawless delivery of mission-critical software components.
Product Engineering Influence: Partner heavily with Databricks Core Engineering and Product leadership. Translate complex, edge-case developer challenges from the field into actionable product roadmap initiatives, APIs, and platform enhancements.
Customer Immersion & Navigation: Embed with customer engineering teams, navigating highly complex organizational structures to deeply understand entrenched software challenges and deliver code-level, systemic impact.
Ecosystem Multiplication: Act as a technical multiplier. Pioneer and open-source massive-scale code accelerators, global development frameworks, and engineering best practices that scale impact across all federal accounts and elevate the entire FDE organization.

Minimum Qualifications

What We're Looking For:

10+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, or distributed systems engineering, with a proven track record of architectural leadership.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Applied Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or equivalent relevant years of experience in an Engineering function.
Expert-level proficiency writing scalable production code in Python, Scala, Java, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, and architecting solutions using modern application frameworks.
Deep, authoritative multi-cloud architectural expertise (AWS, Azure, GCP) with the ability to design cross-cloud or hybrid distributed systems.
Advanced experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and deep internal knowledge of the Spark runtime engine, optimization, and scaling.
Mastery of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform) for complex, high-security production deployments.
Expert knowledge of MLOps, deploying custom ML/AI models, and integrating LLMs and AI APIs into massive-scale production environments.
Proven ability to design and deploy performant, end-to-end software architectures that combine backend services, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces with zero-downtime requirements.
Extensive experience steering complex technical project delivery—managing massive scope, driving agile engineering teams, and translating ambiguous business requirements into actionable, enterprise-grade software solutions.
Exceptional technical documentation, system white-boarding, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex distributed systems to both elite engineers and non-technical executives.
Deep experience working with massive enterprise or federal clients, managing conflicts, and driving consensus across a highly diverse and senior stakeholder range.
Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers, continuously explore new development tools, and push the boundaries of what is possible with Databricks-based solutions.
Travel to customers 20-25% of the time.

Preferred Qualifications

12+ years of experience in software engineering, backend development, and building mission-critical, enterprise-level distributed systems.
Recognized industry thought leadership (e.g., published papers, tech blog posts, open-source maintainer status, or conference speaking experience).
Experience serving on an enterprise architecture board or steering committee.
Certification in a Databricks-specific domain.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

At CelLink, we're not using AI just to build better demos, we're using it to solve real manufacturing challenges.

As an AI Engineer
, you'll turn data from machines, manufacturing systems, quality processes, and engineering teams into AI-powered solutions that improve how we manufacture at scale. That could mean predicting equipment failures before they happen, detecting defects, optimizing processes, improving yield, or building intelligent tools that help engineers make faster, better decisions. The models you build can influence throughput, yield, uptime, quality, equipment reliability, and how quickly our teams solve problems.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Build and deploy AI/ML solutions for manufacturing, quality, equipment reliability, process optimization, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, defect detection, and engineering productivity.
Turn factory data into useful products. Build production-ready models, applications, APIs, and data pipelines using information from manufacturing equipment, MES/ERP, SPC, SCADA, machine vision, databases, and engineering systems.
Solve real manufacturing problems. Partner with Manufacturing, Equipment, Process, Quality, Automation & Controls, Software, and other teams to identify high-value opportunities and turn operational challenges into scalable AI solutions.
Own the full AI lifecycle from data and experimentation through model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Explore what's next. Evaluate and apply machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and AI-enabled workflows where they can create real value.

You will work with both primary research and real-world healthcare data (claims data) to develop innovative analytical solutions that improve the accuracy, efficiency, and predictive power of market research.

What You’ll Do

Secondary Data Healthcare Data Analytics & Research Integration

Define, validate market opportunity for, design and implement secondary data driven client offerings and implementations, using automated scripts, AI, pre-built distributions.
Analyze healthcare datasets, including claims, prescribing, and HCP-level data, to identify trends, patterns, and market opportunities.
Support models that connect attitudinal research segments with real-world healthcare behaviors, including NPI-level data.
Integrate primary and secondary data to improve market understanding, model validation, and predictive accuracy.
Collaborate with research, business development, and technology teams to develop analytical solutions aligned with client needs.

Advanced Analytics & Quant Solutions Innovation

Use and help augment our data platform for secondary data and behavioral intelligence platform to improve and automate existing quant offerings and propose new ones.
Develop and apply statistical models, multivariate techniques, and machine learning algorithms to address research and business questions.
Create joint distributions for our synthetics and automated quant offerings by analyzing primary market research data, including surveys, alongside secondary healthcare data to understand HCP behavior, treatment decisions, and market dynamics.
Contribute to the development and refinement of analytical methodologies to improve the accuracy, predictive power, and efficiency of research.
Translate complex analytical results into clear, actionable business insights and recommendations.
Support the development of analytical models, forecasting tools, and client-facing simulators.

Machine Learning, AI & Innovation

Apply machine learning and AI techniques to enhance segmentation, predictive modeling, demand forecasting, and other advanced analytics applications.
Identify opportunities to automate analytical processes, improve efficiency, and reduce manual work.
Support the development of innovative analytical approaches that integrate primary research with real-world healthcare data.
Explore AI-driven methodologies and tools to expand BioVid's advanced analytics capabilities.

Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Statistics, Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field.

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and analytical workflow automation.

About The Opportunity

A high-growth fintech company modernizing global financial infrastructure and payment processing is looking for an MLOps Engineer. In this role, you will take ownership of the platform that bridges fraud, risk, and transaction models from development notebooks into live production. You will develop the real-time serving infrastructure, automated pipelines, and monitoring tools required to safely score financial transactions as they occur.

Responsibilities

Construct and manage the real-time inference layer handling transaction scoring during live authorizations while meeting strict latency targets and implementing resilient fallbacks.
Design and maintain end-to-end training, testing, and deployment workflows, alongside point-in-time correct feature pipelines derived from transaction, device, and dispute data.
Streamline model release procedures utilizing model registries, version controls, champion/challenger setups, shadow testing, canary deployments, automated evaluations, and rapid rollbacks.
Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting across operational metrics, feature drift, score distributions, and business outcomes such as fraud losses and acceptance rates.
Connect, benchmark, and evaluate third-party risk and fraud services against proprietary models through shadow runs and parallel testing.
Supply underlying risk signals, data feeds, and scoring mechanisms to support customer-facing risk tooling and customizable blocking rules.

Requirements

4+ years of experience in MLOps, machine learning platform engineering, or ML infrastructure.
Background operating production models governed by stringent availability and low-latency standards, particularly within critical decisioning or transaction pathways.
Deep expertise in Python coupled with production engineering practices, along with the ability to read and write TypeScript or Node.js.
Practical experience using machine learning orchestration and inference technologies like MLflow, Kubeflow, BentoML, SageMaker, Feast, or Vertex AI.
Solid foundational infrastructure skills covering containerization, Kubernetes, CI/CD systems, and at least one leading cloud platform.
Data engineering abilities across streaming, data warehouses, and operational stores, including deep familiarity with mitigating training-serving skew.
Track record of monitoring deployed models for drift and calibration while connecting performance indicators to financial outcomes like chargebacks and approvals.
Familiarity with models applied to fraud detection, credit, or risk management, including articulating model decisions to non-technical partners, regulators, or financial institutions.
Routine use of AI-native developer tooling such as Claude Code, or an eagerness to integrate them into daily engineering workflows.
Pragmatic engineering mindset with an emphasis on rapid delivery over delayed perfection.

Professional experience within financial technology, digital payments, or similarly regulated environments.

new_jobs.description:
The Enterprise
Fraud Strategy
group provides bank-wide support for detecting, preventing, and investigating fraudulent activity across multi-channel payment systems.

The Fraud Data Scientist
reports directly to the Manager, Fraud Reporting & Analytics, supporting business reporting and analytical needs for fraud initiatives. The Fraud Data Scientist
works as a member of a reporting and analytics team and utilizes tools for conducting analytics for managing fraud strategies, as well as creating reports consumed by LOB (lines of business) senior executives. This is a subset of the overall responsibilities which involves other multiple initiatives as assigned by Bank Operations leadership.

This role is hybrid (Mon through Thu on-site / Fri remote) for candidates in the Kansas City metropolitan area and open to qualified remote candidates outside of the Kansas City area. However, the remote location must be within the US.

How you will spend your time

Work closely across the organization to develop and implement statistical analysis, artificial intelligence, machine learning processes and algorithms, and deep learning for fraud modeling.
Use dynamic techniques like Machine Learning to gain insights about the future.
Answer the “What will happen, and What should be done?” questions.
Gather business detail from peers and internal customers to adapt/enhance models.
Routinely measure model performance and implement modifications as needed.

We are excited to talk if you have

Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Math, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field and 2+ years of unsupervised data modeling and segmentation experience OR any combination of education and experience that would provide an equivalent background.
Proven expert level foundation of math, statistics, and programming.
Demonstrated hands-on working knowledge of R or Python, Snowflake, SQL Server or similar database management tool and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Superior critical thinking skills.
Strong proficiency in statistical algorithm development and evaluation.
Proficiency in advanced statistics, hyperparameter tuning, A/B Testing, predictive modeling, recommendation systems, propensity scoring, natural language processing, clustering, customer segmentation, data acquisition, mining structured and unstructured data, designing tools, automation systems, and data frameworks.

Bonus Points if you have

Banking or financial services industry experience.
Fraud reporting or analytics experience.

Applicants must have legal authority to work in the United States. Work Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

new_jobs.title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer - VP
new_jobs.description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer - VP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. In this role, you will play a key role in developing financial models and mission-critical trading tools that support a broad range of GMO (Global banking Operations). Working at the forefront of innovative, client-focused financial solutions, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Product Management, and business stakeholders to transform evolving trading strategies and business needs into project plans, requirements, and estimates that align with the firm's overall product and business objectives.

To be successful as a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer - VP, you should have:

Considerable hands-on experience developing production-grade backend applications in Java 17+, with expertise in object-oriented design, concurrency, collections, unit testing, code reviews, and live-production troubleshooting
Proven success designing and delivering Spring Boot microservices and RESTful APIs, including security, configuration management, data access, observability, and scalable service architecture
Experience building event-driven platforms with Kafka, including producers, consumers, topic design, partitioning, consumer groups, and reliable message processing through retries, idempotency, and error handling
Solid understanding of AWS cloud services and cloud-native application delivery, with experience deploying, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting resilient, secure, and high-availability solutions
Practical experience applying AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to business use cases, including document extraction, classification, prompt engineering, output validation, and responsible production integration with human-in-the-loop controls

Other Highly Valued Skills Include

Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for engineering teams, operations functions, product partners, and senior business stakeholders, while strategically managing risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes
Ample DevOps expertise, including CI/CD pipeline implementation, containerization, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, release management, and ownership of monitoring, incident response, and continuous service improvement
Good understanding of Financial Markets and Trade Lifecycle processes, including trade capture, confirmation, validation, settlement, and control frameworks across asset classes such as FX, Rates, and Equities
Proven ability to provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams, promoting engineering best practices, architectural standards, code quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement
Experience serving as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME), designing and delivering scalable, maintainable, and business-aligned technology solutions that meet performance, resilience, and regulatory requirements

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our Whippany, NJ office.

Minimum Salary: $170,000

Maximum Salary: $230,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Barclays employees are eligible for a suite of competitive and generous employee benefits, including medical, dental and vision coverage, 401(k), life insurance, and other paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

This position is eligible for an incentive award.

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0253731

Supply Chain and Infectious Disease Risk Modeling Data Scientist

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Supply Chain Data Scientist to apply advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and data science techniques to assess and strengthen the resilience of critical healthcare supply chains. In this role, you will analyze complex supply chain data, develop data-driven models to identify potential risks and vulnerabilities, and build interactive visualizations and dashboards that translate analytical findings into actionable insights. You will leverage Python, SQL, and data visualization tools to support supply chain risk assessments, inform strategic decision-making, and help government stakeholders anticipate and mitigate disruptions across medical device, diagnostics, and testing supply chains.

Work with us as we use data science for good.  

Join us. The world can't wait.

You Have:  

5+ years of experience in supply chain operations
4+ years of experience with data visualization tools, including Tableau, Power BI, or Python-based libraries, such as Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly
Experience supporting medical device or diagnostics and testing supply chains and working with regulated industries, including FDA supply chain regulations and 21 CFR requirements
Experience in Python, including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or statsmodels, for data wrangling, modeling, and automation, and SQL, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL Server, or BigQuery for querying and managing large relational datasets
Knowledge of end-to-end supply chain processes, including procurement, manufacturing, distribution, and logistics     
Knowledge of statistical analysis, exploratory data analysis, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and machine learning methods
Ability to communicate complex analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership, procurement teams, and regulatory staff
Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements.
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or Supply Chain Management

Nice If You Have:  

Experience with machine learning and statistical modeling techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, time series forecasting, and anomaly detection and familiarity with risk modeling methodologies, such as Monte Carlo simulation, Bayesian inference, or scenario analysis
Experience with National Critical Functions, the Strategic National Stockpile (SNS), or public health emergency preparedness supply frameworks
Experience with network optimization tools or commercial supply chain risk platforms, including Resilinc, Riskmethods, or similar
Experience using AI-assisted development environments or IDEs, such as Claude Code or Cursor, to accelerate coding, debugging, and development workflows
Master's degree preferred; Doctorate degree a plus
APICS CSCP, CPSM, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) certification

Vetting:

Applicants selected will be subject to a government investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements of the U.S. government client.

new_jobs.description:
Position Overview
As an AI Architect in the IS Enterprise Data & Innovation team at C&S, you will help design and implement AI-driven solutions that address business challenges and optimize processes across merchandising, supply chain, store operations, and finance. Working closely with senior architects, data scientists, engineers, and partner teams including Cloud Architecture, Cyber Security, Application Development (AppDev), and the IS AI Committee, you will build and integrate solutions on Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI) and agentic AI frameworks, ensuring they are scalable, secure, compliant with enterprise governance, and aligned with business objectives and the enterprise data and AI strategy. This is a junior-to-mid-level role with significant opportunity to grow into senior architecture responsibilities.

Job Description Key Responsibilities AI Solution Design & Delivery

Design and develop end-to-end AI solutions, including data preprocessing, model development, deployment, and monitoring, under the guidance of senior architects.
Build and integrate machine learning and generative AI solutions (e.g., predictive analytics, natural language processing, retrieval-augmented generation, and agent workflows) on Google Cloud Vertex AI and BigQuery.
Prototype and productionize AI use cases, partnering with data scientists and engineers to move solutions from proof of concept to production.
Evaluate AI frameworks, tools, and technologies (e.g., LangGraph, vector databases, Vertex AI services) and recommend options based on project requirements.

MLOps & Platform Partnership

Contribute to MLOps / LLMOps practices for model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and continuous improvement, using tools such as MLflow, Vertex AI Pipelines, Docker, and GitHub.
Support the scalability, security, and performance of AI solutions within the organization's cloud infrastructure, including access controls and cost awareness.
Help integrate AI services with enterprise applications and data platforms through APIs and standard integration patterns.

Collaboration & Continuous Learning

Work closely with Cloud Architecture, Cyber Security, Application Development (AppDev), and the IS AI Committee to ensure AI solution designs and implementations comply with enterprise governance, security standards, and the enterprise data and AI strategy.
Participate in architecture and design reviews, incorporating feedback on security, data protection, cloud standards, and application integration before solutions move to production.
Collaborate with business partners, data scientists, and engineers to identify opportunities for AI-driven improvements and translate business needs into technical designs.
Contribute to AI roadmaps, reference architectures, documentation, and best practices.
Communicate AI concepts, results, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders to support decision-making.
Stay current with advancements in AI, machine learning, and generative AI, and recommend practical innovations.

Qualifications

Shift

Company C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC

About Our Company

C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC is an industry leader in supply chain solutions and wholesale grocery supply in the United States. Founded in 1918 as a supplier to independent grocery stores, C&S now services customers of all sizes, supplying more than 7,500 independent supermarkets, chain stores, military bases and institutions with over 100,000 different products. C&S also proudly operates and supports corporate grocery stores and services independent franchisees under a chain-style model throughout the Midwest, South and Northeast. PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

PagerDuty is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (SRE Agent)
to join our customer-focused SRE Agent team! As a Forward Deployed Engineer
, you will work inside PagerDuty’s largest customer accounts, connecting the SRE Agent to their production environments (observability tools, infrastructure as code, GitOps tooling, and CI/CD pipelines) and guiding their teams from AI-assisted incident response to supervised and autonomous actions with safety guardrails. You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs.

This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy.

Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption: Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value
Build and contribute core agent capabilities: Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent’s extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates.
Run pilots and unblock customer adoption: Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product.
Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery: Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI-assisted to autonomous operations.
Set technical direction and feedback insights: Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations).
Hands-on experience with LLM and agent systems in production, including agent development, tool-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design.
Customer-facing skills. You can run a technical design session with a customer’s engineers and present the business case to their leadership.
Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role.
A record of shipping software that got adopted, and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build.
Infrastructure & Deployment expertise: Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods).
Willingness to travel 25–50% during active customer engagements.

Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting).
Customer-facing technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background.
Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem-solving.
Experience with policy-as-code, fine-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent-driven automation.
Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms.
Active open-source contributions to the AI agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.

As a Health AI Engineer I
, you will contribute to the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence and machine learning algorithms designed to address meaningful healthcare and product challenges. Working alongside experienced AI/ML engineers, data scientists, clinical experts, and R&D partners, you will help transform healthcare data into algorithms that can be evaluated and ultimately incorporated into medical technology solutions.

This is an entry-level role designed for an engineer who wants to build strong technical foundations in AI/ML while learning how algorithms are developed in a regulated, safety-critical healthcare environment. You will contribute throughout the algorithm development lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, experimentation, evaluation, error analysis, and technical documentation.

Develop, implement, train, and evaluate machine learning and deep learning algorithms under the guidance of experienced AI/ML engineers and technical leads.
Support development of algorithms for healthcare applications, which may include medical imaging, physiological signals, clinical data, multimodal data, or other data generated by medical technologies.
Prepare and curate datasets for algorithm development, including data cleaning, preprocessing, quality checks, annotation/label review, and dataset characterization.
Develop reproducible data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation pipelines using modern AI/ML frameworks and software engineering practices.
Conduct algorithm experiments, tune model parameters, compare alternative approaches, and document experimental results and technical decisions.
Evaluate algorithm performance using appropriate technical and clinically meaningful metrics and contribute to error analysis, robustness testing, subgroup analysis, and identification of potential model limitations.
Create clear visualizations and technical summaries to communicate algorithm performance, tradeoffs, and experimental findings to technical and cross-functional stakeholders.
Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, version control, model and dataset versioning, and other practices that improve the quality and reproducibility of AI development.
Support technical documentation and evidence generation for algorithm design, evaluation, Responsible AI, and product development activities.
Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, Clinical, R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Cybersecurity, and other partners to understand requirements and translate them into technical approaches.
Stay current with relevant developments in machine learning, healthcare AI, and emerging AI technologies and apply appropriate methods to development activities.

Ability to analyze technical problems, work with data, and communicate findings clearly.

Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar AI/ML frameworks.
Familiarity with computer vision, medical imaging, time-series/signal processing, natural language processing, multimodal AI, or related algorithm-development techniques.

Familiarity with Git, software testing, experiment tracking, containers, cloud computing, or MLOps practices.
Understanding of statistical methods and experimental design used to evaluate algorithm performance.
Familiarity with healthcare AI and developing AI systems for regulated, safety-critical environments.
Interest in Responsible AI concepts such as model performance, robustness, transparency, bias/fairness, and ongoing monitoring.
Strong documentation habits and ability to clearly communicate technical methods, results, and limitations.

new_jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Sponsored Products and Brands - Advertiser Growth - Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX)
new_jobs.description:
Description

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities

As An Applied Scientist On This Team You Will

Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
Raise the science bar: review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

About The Team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

Basic Qualifications

3+ years of building models for business application experience
PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using Unix/Linux
Experience in professional software development

Description

The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to build the science that helps Amazon's advertisers grow — with a focus on Cross Border Sellers who face distinct barriers as they scale across multiple marketplaces, and this role is about understanding those pain points deeply and removing them: building intelligent, autonomous solutions that simplify advertising, act efficiently on the advertiser's behalf, and let advertisers accelerate their growth and success.

We expect Scientist to think innovatively about how to reduce the effort and complexity of advertising for these advertisers. Working backwards from their needs — spanning hands-off sellers and global brands with cross-marketplace operations — you will take the lead on medium-to-large, ambiguous problems where neither the problem nor the solution is well defined, invent new methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and deliver customer-facing products with measurable business impact. This role combines science depth, product focus, and hands-on engineering: you will raise the science bar, build consensus on approach across product and engineering partners, and mentor scientists and engineers while remaining deeply hands-on with the hardest technical problems.

Key job responsibilities

As An Applied Scientist On This Team You Will

Understand the pain points of Cross border advertisers as they scale across marketplaces, and build science-driven solutions that remove barriers and accelerate their growth and success.
Build agentic and ML systems that autonomously create, structure, and manage ad campaigns on advertisers' behalf, encoding auction and marketplace dynamics (bidding, budget pacing, targeting decisions) while balancing advertiser ROI, shopper experience, and marketplace health.
Innovate on new, simpler ways to advertise powered by GenAI, and push the frontier of existing autonomous programs (e.g., auto-targeting, global lift-and-shift) while proposing and prototyping the next generation of campaign automation.
Develop models across the campaign lifecycle — opportunity discovery, ranking, ad-readiness and demand prediction, and bid/budget optimization — and apply the right approach for each problem, from classical ML to LLM/reasoning methods.
Define and curate the datasets and signals needed to train and evaluate these systems — advertiser and campaign data, cross-marketplace performance, auction and bid/budget signals, impressions, clicks, conversions, and search-term/keyword performance.
Own core parts of the agentic architecture — planning, tool use and integration (e.g., MCP), reasoning frameworks (e.g., ReAct, CoT/ToT), and model customization — and define evaluation and safety methodology so that automated decisions are reliable and trustworthy.
Stay deeply hands-on: write production-quality, critical-path code and build core components that take systems from prototype to launch on large-scale pipelines (Spark/EMR, Airflow) and online serving.
Raise the science bar: review designs and experiment plans, and communicate results and tradeoffs clearly to technical and business leaders.

About The Team

Autonomous SP drives growth and simplifies advertising for Amazon's hands-off advertisers by creating and enhancing autonomous campaign solutions. We lead existing successful programs, including auto-targeting and global lift-and-shift, and continually innovate by building new, simpler campaign constructs powered by GenAI to act efficiently on advertisers' behalf.

Cross-border Seller Experience (CBSX) focuses on developing targeted solutions for domestic and global advertisers with multi-marketplace operations. By understanding and addressing their unique Seller Central needs, we optimize for cross-marketplace efficiency, improved performance, and streamlined advertising experiences. Our team operates horizontally, delivering impactful solutions that benefit both hands-on and hands-off advertisers globally.

Together, we sit within Sponsored Products and Brands, which is re-imagining advertising through the latest generative AI — building responsible, intelligent systems that balance the needs of advertisers, the shopping experience, and marketplace health.

Join our AI & Engineering
team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering
leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/22/2026.

Lead small engagements or key workstreams within larger technology transformation programs
Own the design and architecture of Claude-based Generative AI and agentic solutions, including RAG pipelines, embeddings and vector databases, orchestration frameworks, memory/state patterns, and tool-use architectures, leveraging the Claude Agent SDK and Claude Cowork
Design and implement cloud and hybrid data architectures, migration approaches, and technology solutions that support Claude/Anthropic deployments

Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships, aligning technical delivery with business and program objectives

Support practice growth through proposal development, thought leadership, and go-to-market content related to agentic AI
Coach and upskill practitioners transitioning onto Generative AI and Claude-focused work

Leading the architecture and delivery of enterprise-scale agentic AI platforms powered by Claude, from design through production operation
Owning technical direction for multi-agent systems spanning orchestration, tool integration, memory/state management, and governance guardrails
Leading modernization of AI/ML or data platforms to incorporate Generative AI capabilities such as RAG pipelines and agent-based orchestration

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

new_jobs.title: MLOps / DevOps Engineer – AI Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
The DevOps Engineer is responsible for supporting and improving cloud and ML/AI infrastructure, automating deployments, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to ensure efficient, secure, and scalable development workflows. This role plays a crucial part in infrastructure automation, monitoring, and cloud security while collaborating with Software and ML Engineers, Product support, QA, and Security teams.

As a key member of the DevOps team, the DevOps Engineer helps manage cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ensuring high availability and compliance with security best practices.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

Cloud Infrastructure, Security & Reliability

Support and maintain scalable, highly available, and secure cloud infrastructure in accordance with company policies and standards.
Provision and manage cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation).
Implement cloud security best practices, including IAM/role-based access controls, encryption, vulnerability management, and secure infrastructure configurations.
Support containerized environments and orchestration platforms.
Apply DevSecOps principles across infrastructure and deployment workflows.
Participate in disaster recovery planning, testing, and recovery activities.

CI/CD, Automation & Deployment

Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD and Jenkins, supporting application and ML model deployments.
Improve deployment reliability and support zero-downtime deployment strategies.
Automate configuration management, infrastructure provisioning, and routine operational processes.
Troubleshoot deployment and pipeline issues and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.
Develop scripts and automation to reduce manual work and improve engineering efficiency.

AI & Agentic Infrastructure

Help design, deploy, operate, and secure infrastructure supporting AI and agentic products, including MCP, agents, integrations, internal tooling, and customer-facing use cases.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools, coding copilots, and AI-driven troubleshooting to improve DevOps productivity and reduce repetitive operational work.
Evaluate and adopt practical AI-enabled workflows that improve infrastructure management, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

MLOps & ML Platform Infrastructure

Operate and scale ML platform infrastructure, including Databricks and Sagemaker clusters, jobs compute, ML pipelines, and Model Serving endpoints.
Manage production model-serving infrastructure, including compute capacity, provisioned throughput, and autoscaling for high-throughput inference workloads.
Maintain infrastructure-level monitoring for model drift, data quality, inference performance, and serving health, while partnering with ML Engineering on model evaluation, quality thresholds, and model correctness.
Partner with ML Engineering to support reliable CI/CD and production deployment of ML models.

Observability, Incident Response & Engineering Collaboration

Maintain monitoring, logging, metrics, and alerting solutions using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Coralogix, and CloudWatch.
Support incident response and perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for infrastructure and deployment-related issues.
Improve system observability through effective log aggregation, metrics collection, monitoring, and alerting.
Partner with Software Engineers, ML Engineers, QA, and Software Engineers in Test to improve deployment workflows and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with IT Security to maintain secure cloud operations and infrastructure policies.
Respond to engineering and Product Support requests in a timely manner and provide technical infrastructure support when needed.
Maintain accurate internal technical and operational documentation.
Collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones

Who you are and what you’ll need for this position:

3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
2+ years of hands-on experience supporting production ML/AI infrastructure, including model serving, training pipelines, and model monitoring.
2+ Hands-on experience with Databricks (clusters, jobs, ML pipelines, Model Serving) and/or AWS SageMaker (endpoints, inference, model deployment, provisioned throughput, autoscaling) in a production environment.
2+ years of hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, SQS, API Gateway, or similar services.
2+ years of experience working with containerized environments and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
Strong experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, or similar technologies.
Strong Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills.
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including routing, load balancing, network security, and related concepts.
Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or similar languages to automate infrastructure and operational tasks.

Nice To Have

Experience with Google Cloud, particularly for candidates who have worked across multi-cloud environments.
Familiarity with Helm and service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, Traefik, or similar tools.
Experience designing serverless and event-driven architectures (beyond basic usage) using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and SQS.
Exposure to cloud and infrastructure security practices, including vulnerability management and tools such as Nessus, Prowler, Trivy, or firewalls.
Knowledge of security standards, compliance requirements, and cloud security best practices.
Experience with observability, log analysis, and monitoring platforms such as Coralogix, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar solutions.
FinOps experience, including cloud cost monitoring, optimization, and accountability practices.
Experience with API gateway or API management platforms such as Kong or Apigee.
Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve engineering workflows, automation, troubleshooting, or agentic use cases.

A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Lead technical delivery across customer engagements. Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires 30–50% travel.

Architect and build production AI systems at scale. Design the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — for the most complex customer engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams. Define operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria for AI systems across your engagement scope. Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness. Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation. Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

new_jobs.title: Base Labs Research Scientist - RL Environments
new_jobs.description:
About Baseten

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

About Base Labs

Base Labs is Baseten’s research lab, working to advance and democratize open-source intelligence. We publish our research, methods, and results so others can inspect, reproduce, and build on them. Baseten’s training and inference infrastructure gives us a place to test ideas at scale, while our work with companies deploying models keeps us close to the problems those models need to solve.

THE ROLE

Models learn from the environments we give them. If a reward is easier to exploit than a task is to solve, a model can learn the shortcut. If a task measures the wrong capability, a higher score tells us little about progress. Building good environments requires decisions about what to teach, how to measure it, and how to establish whether it transfers.

As a Research Scientist at Base Labs specializing in RL environments, you will create open environments and study how models learn from them. You will design tasks and rewards, develop methods for generating and calibrating environments at scale, and run the training experiments needed to understand their effects.

There is substantial reinforcement learning research in this work. We want to understand how task diversity affects generalization, how curricula should change as models improve, and which reward structures produce reliable learning. Your findings will inform both the environments we release and the broader lab’s training research.

Responsibilities

Identify capabilities and failure modes worth studying, informed by real model use. These may include software development, tool use, scientific reasoning, and following complex instructions.
Design task distributions, interactions, rewards, and verifiers together. Establish that tasks are solvable and that success depends on the intended capability. Investigate shortcuts, ambiguous instructions, and weaknesses in grading.
Build methods that scale environment creation without weakening the quality standard. Study how to generate diverse tasks, calibrate difficulty, and detect defects before they spread through a large training pool.
Run RL experiments to measure learning and transfer. Compare curricula, task mixtures, and reward designs; investigate failed runs and unexpected behavior; test whether improvements hold on unseen tasks.
Develop evaluation methods that distinguish capability differences from sampling noise, grader errors, or artifacts of the agent’s tools and execution setup. Preserve the evidence needed to reproduce and challenge your conclusions.
Work with safety researchers on environments that reveal reward hacking and misalignment, and test ways to teach more reliable behavior.
Release environments, datasets, training recipes, and research findings that other teams can use. Make their assumptions, limitations, and measured effects clear.

Who We're Looking For

We look for evidence that you can choose a useful research question, design an informative experiment, implement it, and reason carefully about the result.

You should bring depth in a relevant area such as reinforcement learning, model evaluation, agent systems, synthetic data, or experimental methodology. You should be comfortable writing the code needed to build environments, run experiments, and inspect failures in detail. Experience with LLM training is valuable, as is experience building something that other researchers use.

Your evidence might be a paper, an open-source project or a strong experimental investigation. We also welcome exceptional people from adjacent fields. A PhD or a previous Research Scientist title is not required.

WORKING HERE

We are hiring across levels, with scope matched to experience. You will work closely with research engineers, applied researchers, and the wider Base Labs team. Senior hires will help establish research directions and mentor others. Everyone will contribute to the environments, methods, and published evidence on which the program grows.

Benefits

Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity
(U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents
Flexible PTO policy
Paid parental leave
Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot
(U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)
Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now
to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
Cambridge, MA USA

THE ROLE

As a Senior Associate or Principal at Flagship Pioneering, you will be the protagonist entrepreneur behind a new company built on a pioneering scientific platform. Working side by side with an Origination Partner and using the Flagship model of company origination, you will ideate, research, and refine venture hypotheses, validate the key unknowns of biology or technology, and build pressure-tested ideas into a ambitious and pioneering NewCo. You will connect today’s work with long-term vision and value, understand optionality and paths to value, and navigate from the edges of today’s technology to tomorrow’s transformational biotech platform. You will become the expert on the foundational science of the company, frame and communicate its strategy, grow and manage a team and lead the plan that follows.

The Company

Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) conceives and develops first-in-category bioplatform companies to transform human health and sustainability. FSP has developed over 100 scientific ventures, resulting in more than $130 billion in aggregate value. FSP seeks to change the world by addressing some of humanity’s most urgent challenges: curing intractable diseases, improving human health, and feeding the world by advancing the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Key Responsibilities

Act as primary owner and driver of the company through each phase: exploration, ProtoCo, NewCo and into growth
Lead the loop between computational and experimental work: choose the questions and candidates to pursue, design creative experiments that test predictions, and drive wet lab execution across labs
Set IP strategy for the technology and company, write seminal patent applications, and assess the IP landscape, including key competitors
Develop the corporate strategy and operations plan: define value creation, prioritize the application spaces where the platform has an advantage, set goals and resourcing, and prepare for financing
Build relationships with academic leaders, industry and technology partners, and thought experts to validate and de-risk venture concepts, and develop audience-specific pitches that support business development and financingRecruit and manage the early scientific and computational team, advisors and CROs, set up lab facilities and early operations, and partner with Flagship operations teams and Pioneering Intelligence
Become the institutional subject matter expert and transfer that knowledge to the active company team. Stay current on literature, conferences, funding opportunities and new developments in AI/ML and chemistry

Who Thrives In This Role

You are a scientist-entrepreneur who has helped start something: a member of a founding team at the Senior Associate level, a founder at the Principal level. You bring technical grounding in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering, and the range to solve problems across disciplines as a generalist. You have fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech to hold a point of view and engage computational scientists in depth. You are comfortable driving wet lab work, operating in ambiguity, and originating first-in-category companies through the Flagship model.

Professional Experience & Qualifications

The ideal candidate has a STEM-based PhD or MD from a top university and a technical background in biomolecule design, chemistry and/or engineering that equips them to solve problems across disciplines. Range, judgment and speed of learning count as much as depth in any single field. The candidate must have a passion for novel science and be operationally savvy.

Principal:
8 + years of experience, including founding or co-founding a company, platform or major scientific program. Primary owner of a pioneering scientific endeavor, with a track record of conceiving new science that formed the basis of a platform, and a demonstrated ability to build and lead teams and work with senior executives, boards and investors.

Senior Associate:
4 + years of experience in life sciences biotech, start-up or entrepreneurial activities, including as a member of a founding team with ownership of scientific or technical strategy and execution.

Important Skills And Capabilities Include

Proven ability to rapidly become conversant in new areas of science and engage thought leaders at the deepest technical level
Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and communicate a clear, compelling value proposition for a scientific opportunity to technical and non-technical audiences
Working knowledge of multiple therapeutic modalities of drug discovery
Working fluency in AI/ML as applied to biotech: able to engage computational scientists at depth, navigate the model landscape to identify venture opportunities, and hold a clear point of view on how AI/ML will change the design and execution of scientific platforms and the future of biotech and company origination
Open, transparent communication, a passion for growth, willingness to engage in difficult conversations professionally, and a track record of giving, receiving and acting on feedback
Ability to work effectively in teams, lead and manage, and operate in an entrepreneurial environment with a sense of urgency

More About Flagship Pioneering

Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. 

What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet.

Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture.

Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies.

regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Experience comes in many forms, skills are transferable, and passion goes a long way.
